\begin{example} \end{example}[Hyperbolic torus bundles] \group foliations Source: thurston:page-0081 If $A\in SL(2,\Z )$ is hyperbolic, its mapping torus has two codimension-two hyperbolic foliations from the eigendirections. For $A=\begin{bmatrix} 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$, the mapping torus is a figure-eight Dehn filling with slope $(D,\pm 1)$. All codimension-two hyperbolic foliations with nonclosed leaves arise this way.

\end{example}
